Only the exponent pattern from \(42=6\cdot 7\) gives exponents \(5,6\), which can supply both \(2^5\) and \(5^5\).

Thus the two numbers are
\[
2^5\cdot 5^6 \quad \text{and} \quad 2^6\cdot 5^5.
\]
Their sum is
\[
2^5\cdot 5^6 + 2^6\cdot 5^5
= 2^5 5^5(5+2)
= 10^5 \cdot 7
= 700000.
\]

\[
\boxed{700000}
\]
